purpose: First delayed-activation obstacle-window pilot targeting deterministic recovery followed by success
timing_basis: With a 15 s fixture delay, e016 accepted its goal near simulation time 11.26 s. Activation at 15 s therefore occurs after initial planning and about 3.7 s into execution, before the robot reaches a blocker at 1.5 m. Removal at 17 s brackets one or two 1 s Wait recoveries without using e017 observations.
inclusion_rule: Include in later development evaluation only if simulator/capture gates pass, terminal status is succeeded, recovery history is complete, at least one unique recovery attempt is recorded, and evaluator truth confirms both activation and removal.
mismatch_rule: Retain any valid artifact as calibration and do not alter timings, tune the same run, or relabel its family after observing the result.
evidence_boundary: Obstacle activation/removal and geometry are evaluator-only. Robot-visible explanation inputs may describe only captured BT/action mechanisms unless a separately defined intervention analysis licenses a stronger statement.
